description:
None exist (lib/kernel.fz; import list lib/runtime.fz:19-50). Guards cannot call extern-backed functions: byte_size/Map.size in a guard -> 'helper byte_size/1 is not dispatch-pure'. Guard grammar: guard_expr_from_ast, src/dispatch_matrix/pattern.rs:404-505; helpers via guard_call, src/compiler2/dispatch.rs:107.

Decision (2026-10-17): built-in guard ops, as Elixir's fixed guard BIF list. The guard lowering knows is_integer/is_binary (type tests), map_size/length/elem (primitive ops); the same names are ordinary Kernel functions outside guards, with one runtime implementation each. Distiller uses map_size (line 76), is_integer/is_binary (373, 375), elem, length.

## Design review (2026-10-17)
Fold: Map.size/1 and List.count/1 are not Elixir (13 uses). map_size/1 and length/1 become the single implementation; the Enumerable impls and other users call them, and Map.size/List.count are deleted. elem/2 and tuple_size/1 share one tuple primitive that Tuple.to_list (fz-sc8.14) is written on.
title: Kernel elem/2, length/1, map_size/1, is_integer/1, is_binary/1
